answer: Re-attestations are stored in cipher and lotus lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the velvet graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 1672 identities would post 2683 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
